name: Lectern
description: macOS lecture recorder: local transcription and notes

paragraphs: Lectern is a macOS app for students. It records lectures and shiurim from a microphone, Zoom, or other system audio on your Mac. It transcribes English and mixed English-Hebrew audio and turns it into nested outline notes, flashcards, and quizzes. You can also sync Canvas courses, deadlines, and grades, export notes to Google Docs, and chat with your course documents.

Lectern launches Google's official Antigravity ACP agent on your Mac with a separate Google sign-in. Codex and OpenCode are also supported. Your library stays on your Mac. AI processing sends content to the selected provider; optional Google Docs export and hosted sharing send the content you choose to those services.

Click Install Antigravity so Lectern can download and verify Google's official ACP runtime, then click Sign in with Google.
